title: ONE NAME FOR THE NUMBER KEYS
why: His word in every 10-27 order is hotbar ("items on the hotbar", "hotbar swap"). The row of number keys was named three ways: hotbar on the stash row, belt on the lift and the callouts, tactical belt on the older screens. It is hotbar now on every surface a player reads.
now: the number key row says hotbar everywhere: the backpack panel, the lift, the pad legends, the raid callouts and the stash words

edits.anchor: Your inventory is your backpack plus your tactical belt. An item is in one or the other, never both.
edits.replacement: Your inventory is your backpack plus your hotbar. An item is in one or the other, never both.
